name: Hoshitsugu Shirone
source:
"Shirone is a popular person, you know? Please don't lump me in with someone like Nii-san."

A first-year student. While being a figure skater, she also engages in magazine modeling and other entertainment activities, a promising star in the figure skating world. She is currently recuperating from her injury, aiming to return to the "National Athletic Meet" by the end of the year. Perhaps because she is always being seen by other people, she acts pleasantly in public, but when in front of her older brother Hoshitsugu Kotetsu, she does whatever she wants and behaves outrageously. On the other hand, because her parents tend to be away, she trusts Kotetsu and loves his home-cooked meals more than anything.

[Translated and edited from the [url=http://azarashi-soft-plusone.nexton-net.jp/aikotoba-sss/character.html]official website[/url]]
